remarks: Welcome to 1142 Folsomdale Road, a spacious country property offering nearly 1,924 sq. ft. of living space on approximately 3.5 acres. This 3-bedroom, 1-bath home combines warm rustic character, flexible living space and an impressive outdoor setting surrounded by mature trees and expansive lawn.A substantial addition completed in 2003 added a spacious living room, playroom and convenient first-floor laundry room. The inviting living space features a vaulted wood ceiling, fireplace and abundant natural light, while the roomy kitchen offers plentiful cabinetry and a large center island with seating.The oversized primary bedroom is a standout, showcasing hardwood floors, exposed beams, a wood-burning stove and an impressive walk-in closet/dressing area. Natural woodwork and hardwood flooring throughout much of the home add to its distinctive country character.Outside, the property offers plenty of room to relax, entertain and enjoy the surroundings. Multiple outdoor living spaces include a covered patio and separate covered entertaining area overlooking the expansive yard. A large detached barn/outbuilding with a paved driveway provides valuable additional space for vehicles, storage, equipment, hobbies or workshop use.With nearly 2,000 sq. ft., approximately 3.5 acres, a large outbuilding, multiple outdoor entertaining spaces and a versatile floor plan, 1142 Folsomdale Road offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy space, privacy and country living.
